author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬಾಳದೋಣಿಯು ತಾನು ತೆರೆಗಂಜಿ ನಿಂತೊಡನೆ
ಆಳ ಅಗಲವನರಿತು ಚಾಲನೆಯ ಮಾಡು
ತಾಳೆಹಾಕುತ ನಡೆಯೆ ಸಂಯಮದ ನಡೆನುಡಿಯ
ಸೀಳಿ ನಡೆಯುವೆ ಸುಳಿಯ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When the boat of life stops, afraid of the waves,
know the depth and breadth and steer it on;
walk in rhythm, with restrained words and deeds,
and you will cut through the whirlpool, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: When life’s boat is stalled by fear, understand the waters and keep steering. Measured speech and conduct carry us through even the whirlpools.
